name: MorphingText
description: A phrase that blurs and cross-fades into the next phrase in a list, in the same spot. The slot is as wide as the longest phrase, so nothing around it jumps.

texts.description: The phrases to morph through, in order.

interval.description: Milliseconds each phrase stays before the next one replaces it.

duration.description: Milliseconds the blur and cross-fade take.

label.description: Accessible name for the whole slot. Defaults to all the phrases, joined with commas.

isPaused.description: Stops the animation and shows the finished text. Moving content that lasts more than five seconds should be stoppable.

requirements: The slot has an accessible name listing every phrase once, and the visible layers are hidden from assistive technology
Hidden sizing copies of the other phrases are invisible to everyone, so nothing is read twice
Decoration only: the animated layers are hidden from assistive technology and never take focus
Stands still for visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion), and can also be shown still with the rdm-still class or isPaused
In forced-colors (high contrast) mode the text is drawn in the system colours with no effect
Does not flash: nothing changes more than three times in a second (WCAG 2.3.1)
The text is real text in the server HTML, readable with no script
Optional: it is a separate component, so projects that do not add it carry none of its code
screenReader: The list of all phrases, once

use_when: A hero line that cycles through a few short statements
Showing a range of things a product handles
avoid_when: Phrases that carry information people must not miss
anti_patterns: Putting a different meaning in each phrase and expecting every one to be read
Very short intervals, which make the text hard to read
